stories.name: ExxonMobil LNG Projects
stories.blurb: ExxonMobil is advancing major LNG developments in Mozambique and Papua New Guinea, awarding contracts and taking over operatorship to expand its global liquefied natural gas portfolio.

stories.name: Chevron Stock Rally

4.text: ExxonMobil awarded SLB's OneSubsea a contract for subsea systems on Mozambique's Rovuma LNG first phase, and signed Vietnam crude supply deals with BSR. It also faces a $5.2 billion Kazakhstan fine with partners, while former executives joined TMC and Empower boards.

7.text: Oil near $90 and rising prices are expected to boost ExxonMobil and Chevron Q3 earnings, with focus on refining margins, LNG, Venezuela, and Permian growth. One article calls both stocks cheap laggards; another notes energy lagged tech despite gains.

5.text: Oil prices spiked above $91 (WTI) and $100 (Brent) amid the Iran conflict, disrupted shipping, tight diesel supplies, and China halting fuel exports, while the US released another 40 million barrels from strategic reserves at 44-year lows. The articles don't mention ExxonMobil directly, but higher crude prices imply increased profits for major oil producers.

6.text: ExxonMobil is expanding low-cost Guyana and Permian output, signed Vietnam supply deals, and advanced Texas carbon capture while returning $9.4 billion to shareholders last quarter. Analysts split: TD Cowen raised its target to $180, while Wells Fargo downgraded to Equal-Weight with a $182 target.
